liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Gimme Some Lovin'** (4 reviews): Described as a big breakout coming out of a soulful Wharf Rat just before drums; Phil opens it aggressively out of Wharf Rat, and Brent sings pop-metal style harmonies during the song [14][16][21][25]
- **Smokestack Lightning** (3 reviews): Reviewer says it was the first west coast Smokestack, with Spoonful sandwiched in the middle, all in set one; Reviewer says Smokestack into Spoonful and back to Smokestack was played only this once, and the show never lets up [14][23][25]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Opening Jack Straw is played with high energy; Reviewer calls this a really hot Jack Straw [17][20]
- **Slipknot!** (2 reviews): Help on the Way into Slipknot suffers miscues, and Slipknot nearly falls apart at its start; Slipknot into Franklin's teeters and nearly derails but holds together, which makes it more intriguing [17][25]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Bobby forgot the words, and the look Jerry gave him still makes the reviewer laugh [18]
- **Spoonful** (1 review): Putting Spoonful into Smokestack, with Iko Iko closing the set, sets up a strong second set [19]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Gimme Some Lovin' [26]

## The recordings

- **gd84-11-02.sbd.connor.10172.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 154 min; rated 4.4/5 by 20 [1]. Said about its sound: Brent's voice sounds odd, as if run through a filter [17]
- **gd1984-11-02.152202.sbd.eichorn.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 153 min [2]. Said about its sound: Set one of the earlier source ran badly slow and sounded like sludge before correction [2]
- **gd1984-11-02.179390.unknown.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 155 min [3]
- **gd1984-11-02.169043.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 152 min [5]

## Around the show

- Small theater; reviewer got last-minute seats in row six and shared one seat with a friend [14]
- Jerry and Bobby seemed to be trying to outdo each other all night [18]
- Reviewer believes Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance into Wharf Rat happened only at this show [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-11-02.sbd.connor.10172.sbeok.shnf**: source: Tony G shntool fix of original Braverman SBD seed [1]
- **gd1984-11-02.152202.sbd.eichorn.flac16**: transferred by Roger Eichorn; source: This is a speed- and pitch-corrected version of SET 1 of shnid:010172 [2]
- **gd1984-11-02.179390.unknown.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; Unknown mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII) [3]. Also: Doug Lamarre's Sennheiser 441 source supplies crowd sound, the start of Iko Iko, and patches in Wharf Rat and Good Lovin' [3]
- **gd1984-11-02.169043.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > ?? > Jim Vita's cassettes (Maxell XLII-S) [5]. Also: Lamarre's 441 source patches Wharf Rat and the end of Casey Jones; Rich Gastwirt's source patches Drums [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-10-30 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-10-30-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [27]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-11-03 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-11-03-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [28]
- Poster by Steven Rood Grateful Dead: [1984-10-31 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-10-31-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [29]
